brief.headline: Close the ₹82,500 price gap on measuring cups and tighten payment terms to 30 days to free up ₹10.19 L in cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Ask Mars Plastics to match Premier Plastic's ₹0.35/NOS on measuring cups (MESU. CUP 30MM TRANS.PP 2.5/5/10ML).
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹0.38/NOS; Premier Plastic delivers the same item at ₹0.35/NOS — an 8.6% gap. The market shows modest room to go lower (₹0.65–0.80 typical for similar caps at volume), so ₹0.35 is fair and proven by our own buys.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days after receipt to 30 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹10.19 L in cash for us to use elsewhere.

brief.financialLeverage: Mars Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or cash position. Our ₹1.24 Cr spend is real money, but without their revenue figure we don't know if we're 2% or 20% of their business. The good news: we have four strong alternates already qualified (Mold-Tek, Hitech, Manjushree, Pravesha) and six manufacturer/recycler leads to develop. That backup lineup gives us room to push firmly on price and terms — just keep the tone constructive so we don't lose a working supplier before the second source is locked in.

evidence.point: We are overpaying ₹82,500 a year on measuring cups versus what Premier Plastic charges us
Premier Plastic delivers the same measuring cup (MESU. CUP 30MM TRANS.PP 2.5/5/10ML) at ₹0.35/NOS; Mars charges ₹0.38/NOS — an 8.6% gap
Cutting payment terms from 45 days to 30 days frees up ₹10.19 L in cash for us
The open market shows typical pricing for a similar 28 mm PP cap at ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: askBand: ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical: ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict: MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) specializing in pharma bottles, caps and preforms — top second-source candidate already qualified by us for packaging.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) for pails, containers and pharma — strong, profitable, already qualified as a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Pan-India manufacturer of plastic materials — a lead to qualify before we send an RFQ; not yet verified or priced.

risks: Mars Plastics does not publish financials, so we're negotiating blind on their cash health — watch for signs they can't absorb shorter terms or a price cut without stumbling.
We spend ₹1.24 Cr with them but have no revenue figure to gauge our leverage — we may be a tiny customer or a major one; probe gently in the meeting to understand our weight.
We have four qualified alternates and six manufacturer leads, but none are fully onboarded yet — don't burn the bridge with Mars until a second source is producing and delivering on time.

The ₹82,500 saving hinges on one SKU (measuring cups); if Mars walks and the alternate has a longer lead time, we risk a stockout on that item — line up safety stock or an expedited trial order from Premier or Manjushree before pressing hard.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, and today we'd like to close the gap on measuring cups — Premier Plastic is at ₹0.35 and we'd like you to match that — and move to 30-day terms to help both of us move faster.
